Pass ordinary source text as the text argument; do not add another layer of JSON escaping. Follow the existing registration pattern of other built-in commands. Preserve existing lines and place module-level definitions outside existing classes, after required decorators, and before first use. Check names are defined before use and serialize existing values safely. Omit unrelated edits. Use run_terminal for read-only Git checks when relevant. Be concise in your final summary.
